# Press Release Details


## SL Green Realty Corp. to Present at the BofA Securities 2026 Global Real Estate Conference on September 15, 2026


Aug 25, 2026 at 4:05 PM EDT


[PDF Version](https://slgreen.gcs-web.com/node/31466/pdf)


NEW YORK, Aug. 25, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- SL Green Realty Corp. (NYSE: SLG), Manhattan’s largest office landlord, today announced that Harrison Sitomer, President and Chief Investment Officer, Matt DiLiberto, Chief Financial Officer, and Steven Durels, Executive Vice President and Director of Leasing and Real Property, of SL Green will participate in a roundtable discussion at the BofA Securities 2026 Global Real Estate Conference on Tuesday, September 15, 2026 at 12:45pm ET. The roundtable will be webcast.


The live audio webcast can be accessed in listen only mode via the Investors section of the SL Green Realty Corp. website at[www.slgreen.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=FfQ2esowEl6zw2dI7iU_cUADZKEEXB9_JBSaSvwpUk-vEm1BK9nygPks1Ji7mENF7q1q1ZmELxRyzPqSoDEauA==) under “Presentations & Webcasts”. A replay of the webcast will be available via the same link.


**About SL Green Realty Corp.**


SL Green Realty Corp., Manhattan’s largest office landlord, is a fully integrated real estate investment trust, or REIT, that is focused primarily on acquiring, managing and maximizing the value of Manhattan commercial properties. As of June 30, 2026, SL Green held interests in 54 buildings totaling 30.6 million square feet, which included ownership interests in 29.2 million square feet and 1.4 million square feet securing debt and preferred equity investments, excluding fund investments, and managed 4 buildings totaling 0.9 million square feet owned by third parties.
